reason: E1 shows that fine, uniformly distributed intermetallics (Ti2Zn, Mg21Zn25) in MgTiZn alloys promote a protective surface film and high corrosion resistance, directly supporting the role of intermetallic morphology in passivation. However, the cited evidence does not address thermally activated Mg diffusion as the nucleation mechanism, nor does it compare fine vs. coarse intermetallic effects on oxide continuity or high-temperature oxidation; E2 discusses oxidation in a different alloy system and is not directly relevant.
